name: PlaywrightExecutorAgent
description: Runs the Action Generation Engine's plans in real Chromium browsers (one shared login, fresh context per plan, up to 3 in parallel) and records per-step outcomes, screenshots, page text, chat replies, downloaded files, network calls and console errors as durable run artifacts; verdicts are left to Output Validation and Pass/Fail.

inputs.name: action_plan
inputs.description: ActionGenerationAgent output; ready plans are executed

inputs.name: live_url
inputs.description: Base URL of the deployed app; brd_only / empty skips

inputs.name: live_credentials
inputs.description: {username, password} for the single shared login; never persisted

outputs.name: execution_run
outputs.description: status, reason, login, duration_s, counts, results[{plan_id, test_id, test_code, criterion_code, status, failed_step, error, steps[], captures{screenshot, dom_text, dom_excerpt, reply, downloads[], response}, observations{network, console_errors, page_errors, http_errors}, expectations[]}]
